stock.description: Prime Intelligence Solutions Group Limited functions as an investment holding company primarily engaged in distributing biometric identification technology and security solutions across Hong Kong, Macau, and the People's Republic of China. Its sophisticated biometric devices offer diverse identification capabilities, encompassing facial recognition, fingerprint scanning, finger vein analysis, hand geometry, and iris detection. The company also provides various other hardware and accessories, alongside a comprehensive suite of support services, including installation, maintenance, and customized solution development. Additionally, it offers application software bundled with post-sale assistance, specialized repair and upkeep services, and software licensing. Established in 1999, the group's corporate headquarters are located in Kwai Chung, Hong Kong.
